review: 729.2a, 729.5a: the skip reasons did not hold (the Attraction deck's zone is observable and Forge's SubgameEffect implements the move); added scenario 729.2a-1 with Coming Attraction opening Concession Stand in the subgame, contrasted with the Stand sitting on the main-game battlefield.

scenarios.title: Only the subgame's winner and loser matter to the main game

setup.notes: Subgame life totals start at 20 whatever the main-game totals.

decisions: A casts Shahrazad, tapping two Plains. Both players pass; Shahrazad resolves and the subgame is played.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Both players have three cards, draw them all, and lose the subgame at its first state-based check, so it is a draw and nobody wins. A loses 10 life (10) and B loses 8 (7), computed from the main-game totals. Nothing else from the subgame carries over.

variants.label: b_wins
variants.delta: B's library has 20 Mountains instead of 3.
variants.expected: A loses the subgame and B wins. A loses 10 life (10) and B's life stays 15.

scenarios.forge_notes: A subgame draw leaves both players not winning; Forge treats isWinner as false for both.

scenarios.title: Only libraries enter the subgame; the main game's other zones stay outside
decisions: A casts Shahrazad, tapping two Plains. Both players pass; Shahrazad resolves and the subgame is played.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The subgame starts with A's 20 Plains and B's 3 Mountains as libraries, empty hands and battlefields and 20 life each. Grizzly Bears and Shock are not in it. B has three cards and loses at the first state-based check. Afterwards Grizzly Bears is still on A's battlefield, Shock is still in A's hand, and B loses 10 life (10).

variants.label: bears_in_library
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is in A's library (replacing one Plains) instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is part of the subgame's library, so it may be drawn there. When the subgame ends it is back in A's main-game library, not on the battlefield, and B loses 10 life (10).

scenarios.forge_notes: Which player goes first in the subgame is random and not asserted here.

scenarios.title: The Attraction deck moves into the subgame and back out of it

setup.notes: The listed zones and life totals belong to the subgame, which Shahrazad (cast by A) started. Main game: Shahrazad is on the stack, main-game life is A 20 and B 20, and A's Attraction deck in the main-game command zone holds exactly one card, Concession Stand. B has no Attraction deck.

decisions: A casts Coming Attraction, tapping three Forests, searches for a Forest and puts it onto the battlefield tapped, then opens an Attraction. Both players pass; Coming Attraction resolves.
A passes through to B's turn. B draws from an empty library and loses the subgame; Shahrazad finishes resolving.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Opening an Attraction puts Concession Stand onto A's subgame battlefield. When the subgame ends, Concession Stand is in A's Attraction deck in the main-game command zone, not on a battlefield and not in A's library. B loses 10 life (10); A's life stays 20.

variants.label: stand_on_main_battlefield
variants.delta: Concession Stand is on A's main-game battlefield, opened earlier, instead of in A's main-game Attraction deck.
variants.expected: A's subgame Attraction deck is empty, so opening an Attraction puts nothing onto the battlefield. After the subgame Concession Stand is still on A's main-game battlefield and A's Attraction deck is empty. B loses 10 life (10).

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge's SubgameEffect copies the main-game Attraction deck into the subgame's AttractionDeck zone and leaves the main-game deck untouched; at the end it discards the subgame copies, so the main-game deck still holds the original Concession Stand rather than a card moved back face down. A one-card Attraction deck is a puzzle-style setup.

scenarios.title: A subgame player with fewer than seven cards loses at the first upkeep
decisions: A casts Shahrazad, tapping two Plains. Both players pass; Shahrazad resolves and the subgame is played.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B draws its three cards, fails to draw four more, and loses the subgame at the state-based check of the first upkeep. B loses 10 life (10); A's life stays 20.

variants.label: exactly_seven
variants.delta: B's library has 7 Mountains instead of 3.
variants.expected: B draws all seven cards and is not eliminated at the first upkeep. B loses later by drawing from an empty library, and still loses 10 life (10) once the subgame ends.

scenarios.title: A card pulled out of the main game triggers its leave ability only after the main game resumes

setup.notes: The listed zones and life totals belong to the subgame, which Shahrazad (cast by A) started. Main game: Shahrazad is on the stack, main-game life is A 20 and B 20, and A's main-game battlefield has Tocasia's Onulet and Grizzly Bears, both owned by A.

decisions: A casts Living Wish, tapping two Forests, and chooses Tocasia's Onulet from outside the game as the card to put into hand. Both players pass; Living Wish resolves.
A passes through to B's turn. B draws from an empty library and loses the subgame; Shahrazad finishes resolving and the main game resumes. Both players pass; the main-game trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Tocasia's Onulet leaves the main-game battlefield while the subgame is in progress, but its trigger does not go on the stack then. After B loses and Shahrazad's life loss finishes (B 20 to 10), the trigger goes on the stack and resolves, A gaining 2 life (22). Tocasia's Onulet is in A's main-game library.

variants.label: no_leave_trigger
variants.delta: A chooses Grizzly Bears from outside the game instead of Tocasia's Onulet.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears leaves the main-game battlefield and no trigger goes on the stack. B loses 10 life (10), A's life stays 20, and Grizzly Bears is in A's main-game library.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge builds the subgame Sideboard zone from the main game's hand, battlefield, graveyard, exile and stack cards, and moves the original to its Subgame zone.

scenarios.title: Main-game counters stay out of the subgame and subgame counters vanish

setup.notes: The listed zones and life totals belong to the subgame, which Shahrazad (cast by A) started. Main game: Shahrazad is on the stack, main-game life is A 20 and B 20, and A has 3 rad counters in the main game.

decisions: A casts Contaminated Drink with X = 2, tapping all four lands. Both players pass; it resolves.
A passes through to B's turn. B draws from an empty library and loses the subgame; Shahrazad finishes resolving.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: In the subgame A has only the 1 rad counter it just received, not the 3 main-game counters. When the subgame ends the subgame counter is gone and A has exactly 3 rad counters in the main game. B loses 10 life (10).

variants.label: no_main_counters
variants.delta: A has no rad counters in the main game instead of 3.
variants.expected: A's subgame rad counter does not survive: A has 0 rad counters in the main game afterwards. B loses 10 life (10).

variants.label: no_subgame_counters
variants.delta: A does not cast Contaminated Drink and gets no rad counter in the subgame.
variants.expected: A has exactly 3 rad counters in the main game afterwards and B loses 10 life (10).

scenarios.forge_notes: Setup lists subgame zones; main-game state is in notes.

scenarios.title: Subgame cards return to the main-game libraries when it ends
decisions: A casts Shahrazad, tapping two Plains. Both players pass; Shahrazad resolves and the subgame is played.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The subgame ends when B loses at the first upkeep. B's three Mountains and A's seven drawn Plains return to the main-game libraries, which again hold 3 and 20 cards. Shahrazad then finishes resolving: B loses 10 life (10) and Shahrazad goes to A's graveyard.

variants.label: long_subgame
variants.delta: B's library has 20 Mountains instead of 3.
variants.expected: Whatever happens in the subgame, once it ends both main-game libraries again hold 20 cards, no subgame object remains, and Shahrazad finishes resolving.

variants.label: outside_cards_stay
variants.delta: B has Hill Giant in its main-game graveyard.
variants.expected: Hill Giant is outside the subgame and is not put into B's library: it stays in B's graveyard and B's library holds 3 cards. B loses 10 life (10).

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge leaves the main-game library cards in place and discards the subgame's copies, so the main-game library keeps the same card count, though the card objects differ.

scenarios.title: A subgame inside a subgame treats the first subgame as its main game

setup.notes: The listed zones and life totals belong to the first subgame, which an earlier Shahrazad cast by A in the main game started. Main game: that Shahrazad is still on the stack and main-game life is A 20 and B 20. B has Counterspell available but only casts it in the countered variant.

decisions: A casts Shahrazad in the subgame, tapping two Plains. B passes (it does not cast Counterspell); Shahrazad resolves and the nested subgame is played.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The nested subgame uses the first subgame's libraries (A 20 Plains, B 3 Mountains). B has three cards and loses it. B loses 10 of its first-subgame life (10) and A's stays 20. The first subgame resumes at A's precombat main phase and the main game's life totals stay 20 and 20.

variants.label: both_short
variants.delta: A's library has 3 Plains instead of 20.
variants.expected: Both players lose the nested subgame, so it is a draw. A and B each lose 10 first-subgame life (10 and 10). The main game's life totals stay 20 and 20.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell on Shahrazad, tapping its two Islands.
variants.expected: Shahrazad is countered and no nested subgame starts. Both first-subgame life totals stay 20 and both libraries keep their cards.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge SubgameEffect builds a Game with the first subgame as parent; nested use has no card script exercising it.
